package.name: armo_span
package.description: libarmo_span.so: armo_span_begin and armo_span_end, empty functions that mark a stretch inside a callback, the C++ armo::Span and the Python decorator armo_span.span around them. armo catches them by name (LD_PRELOAD and LTTng) or attaches to them (uprobe); without armo a span costs its two calls.
